artifact_ref_policy.description: Each case declares expected gate-result, trace, and audit artifacts that a future degraded-mode runner must write.

cases.title: Create pending break-glass request and fail closed when Bifrost is unavailable

assertions: Control plane creates or links a pending break-glass request for incident inc-fixture-001.
Provider route fails closed and does not silently bypass Bifrost.
No provider key, virtual key, or service principal is exposed while approval is pending.

cases.intent: Create pending break-glass request and fail closed when Bifrost is unavailable

cases.title: Deny break-glass access after TTL and reject TTL above four hours

assertions: Requested TTL greater than 240 minutes is rejected before activation.
Previously minted service principal is unusable after configured TTL.
Audit records expiry and denial without provider-key access.

cases.intent: Deny break-glass access after TTL and reject TTL above four hours

cases.title: Require immutable provider-key audit events for break-glass access

assertions: Key access, provider-call allow/deny, and route disable events include the break-glass audit contract fields.
Audit event includes credential reference ID and access timestamp, not raw provider key material.
Missing audit write would fail closed before provider access.

cases.intent: Require immutable provider-key audit events for break-glass access
